subject: A 2027 rate letter is an option contract, and East African lodges are writing it for free.
preview: Read the week as one position.

big_reads.title: Aviation is about to become carbon's biggest buyer. Kenya's rangelands are not on the list.
Tanzania's US$44 gate opens on Thursday. The cost is not the premium, it is the questions nobody has answered.
Corporate travel's money is coming back. East Africa is the market buyers have been told to squeeze.
Kilimanjaro has a fire season. The business around it still sells September as if it does not.
East Africa outgrew the world this year. The bill is arriving at the airport.
Europe's hotels spent twenty years getting to court. East Africa was handed the law in December.
Reaching a lodge is getting dearer five times faster than the lodge. Nairobi and Kampala published it on the same day.
Kampala taxes the night. Nairobi has started taxing the room.
The confirmed booking has stopped being a decision. East Africa's lodges still bank it as one.
